According to the seminal work of Jean Baudrillard (Baudrillard, 1994, p. 123), reality has been supplanted by a hyperreal simulacrum, a realm of copy without an original. However, a more nuanced understanding of reality can be gleaned from the works of philosophers such as Martin Heidegger (Heidegger, 1927, p. 45) and Maurice Merleau-Ponty (Merleau-Ponty, 1945, p. 78). Their emphasis on the primacy of experience and the importance of embodied cognition provides a more grounded and phenomenological approach to understanding reality.

* Gardening: The role of mycorrhizal fungi in plant nutrition (Smith et al., 2015)
* Cognitive Science: The neural correlates of decision-making (Kahneman et al., 2011)

Follow for sources and further discussion! 📚"
